hints: Without dots this is the trie walk from `prefix-tree`: one child per letter, and the node must end a word.
A dot is the only difference, and it is one line: instead of following the one matching child, try every child that exists.
That makes the walk branch, so it is a depth-first search rather than a straight descent - and it succeeds if any branch does.
Every branch still consumes exactly one letter of the pattern, so the search naturally only ever reaches nodes at the right depth.
